# Unsent FINOS sponsorship request

Subject: Member sponsorship discussion — MessageBench preservation testing

MessageBench is a small offline tool for checking declared information preservation across financial-message adapters. Its release candidate supports pacs.008.001.08 and pacs.002.001.10 only, with 100 synthetic paired cases and deterministic reports that disclose tested and unexamined information. It does not initiate payments or certify ISO/SWIFT/scheme conformance.

We would welcome a FINOS Member maintainer's assessment of fit and, if useful, willingness to sponsor a project proposal through the existing contribution process. The repository and technical paper are https://github.com/aksum-labs/messagebench and its paper/ directory. Separate standard-schema terms and absent independent human review are disclosed in the rights register and release-readiness notes.

Aksum Labs is prepared to discuss neutral governance and constructive contributions to existing FINOS projects. We have not purchased membership and make no sponsorship claim. An accountable owner will supply actual maintainers, contribution commitments and any authorized legal signatory before filing.

This draft has not been sent. Owner approval is required before community outreach or formal submission.
